name: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6
summary: Meituan LongCat's open-weights model for audio-driven talking-avatar video: give it a portrait image (or text) plus a voice track and it generates lip-synced video of one or several speakers, with continuation past 10 minutes while keeping identity stable. 1.6 (released 2026-11-13) improves lip sync and expressiveness over 1.5 and ships INT8 weights and two task LoRAs. MIT licensed, usable for dubbing, tutors, explainers.

access.notes: Weights MIT, not gated. Bundles Whisper-large-v3 and a vocal-separator ONNX with their own terms. No Meituan trademark/patent rights. Reference demos use 2+ GPUs (torchrun); Hopper FP8 path optional. Get consent before animating real people.

procedure: git clone https://github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video and install its requirements (Python 3.10, conda) plus the avatar requirements
Run run_demo_avatar_single_audio_to_video.py (or the multi-audio script) with --checkpoint_dir and a LoRA from loraA/ or loraB/, following the README examples

stats.count: base transformer (6 shards) + INT8 variant + 2 LoRAs

verdict.why: Fresh (11-13) MIT open-weights talking-avatar model from a credible lab (LongCat-Video repo 9.4k stars; v1.5 had 907 HF likes). Pages, HF repo and GitHub MIT LICENSE verified. Caveats: heavy multi-GPU inference, bundled third-party components, deepfake misuse risk.
